scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=packages/server & npm run dev --workspace=packages/client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/server && npm run build --workspace=packages/client
scripts.build:pages: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/server && npm run build --workspace=packages/client -- --mode pages
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/server && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
